style: Create a new image. Photorealistic still frame from a fixed municipal traffic (ANPR) camera on a pole about 6 m high, looking down at the road at about 30 degrees, slight wide-angle lens, realistic CCTV look (mild noise, slightly muted colours). Same fictional Mediterranean coastal city as the previous images (cream limestone, ochre, green shutters, palms and plane trees), bright overcast late afternoon, soft diffuse light, dry asphalt. The subject is EXACTLY the burgundy hatchback from the reference image (same model, colour, wheels, no badges). Its licence plate is BLANK white EU style with a blue left band and no characters, fully visible, sharp, unobstructed, about 10-14% of the image width. Other vehicles small/distant with unreadable plates. NO text, timestamps, overlays, logos or watermarks. Road markings must be physically coherent: continuous lane lines in correct perspective, constant lane widths, no duplicated or broken-off lines; the car is fully inside its lane. Landscape 3:2. SCENE:

shots.pu-1: the port gate. The car is seen from BEHIND, driving away along a two-lane harbour road that starts to curve gently to the left; container cranes, stacked containers and a warehouse on the right, a glimpse of the sea and moored boats on the left, palm trees.
shots.pu-2: the harbour road curving to the left between old port warehouses painted white and pale blue, a row of palms, cranes far behind. The car is seen from the FRONT, approaching the camera along the curve.
shots.pu-3: the harbour road still curving left, now leaving the port: the first 5-storey residential blocks with balconies appear on the right, a palm-lined median. The car is seen from BEHIND driving away.
shots.pu-4: the harbour road arriving at a small roundabout just behind the car; beside the roundabout an early-20th-century red-brick fish market hall with tall arched windows and a tiled roof. The car is seen from the FRONT, approaching the camera, having just come round the bend.
shots.lo-1: a small roundabout with a low stone fountain on a planted central island; the red-brick fish market hall with arched windows on one side. The car is seen from the FRONT entering the roundabout.
shots.lo-2: camera mounted on the central island of the small roundabout (fountain edge visible in the lower corner) looking at the car circulating around the island; the car is seen in rear three-quarter view; the red-brick fish market hall with arched windows behind it.
shots.lo-3: the exit of the small roundabout onto a wide straight boulevard with a tree-lined central median; the fish market hall at the edge of the frame. The car is seen from BEHIND as it leaves the roundabout onto the boulevard.
shots.av-1: a wide straight boulevard (two lanes each way, central median with plane trees, cycle lane) between modern 7-storey apartment blocks with shops; far ahead, the road dips towards a tunnel mouth under a riverside embankment. The car is seen from BEHIND.
shots.tu-s: the south portal of a road tunnel under a river: the boulevard dips into a dark concrete tunnel mouth clad in stone; above the portal a riverside parapet with railings and trees. The car is seen from BEHIND, just about to enter the tunnel.
shots.tu-n: the north portal of the same river tunnel: the road rises out of a stone-clad tunnel mouth (tunnel lights glowing inside behind the car), a stone parapet above. The car is seen from the FRONT, just emerging from the tunnel.
shots.av-2: a wide straight boulevard north of the river: two lanes each way, central median with plane trees, early-20th-century 7-storey blocks with shops and cafes at street level. The car is seen from BEHIND.
shots.av-3: the same wide boulevard, mid-block, shop fronts with awnings, plane trees on the median. The car is seen from the FRONT approaching.
shots.av-4: the same wide boulevard seen from a camera on a pole in the central median; ornate early-20th-century facades, a newsstand, plane trees. The car is seen from BEHIND driving away.
shots.av-5: the same wide boulevard, a pedestrian crossing, cafes with terraces. The car is seen from the FRONT approaching.
shots.av-6: the same wide boulevard beside a tram stop with a glass shelter (no tram), modern and old buildings mixed. The car is seen from BEHIND.
shots.av-7: the end section of the wide boulevard; ahead on the left a short steep street climbs up a hill between stone retaining walls. The car is seen from the FRONT approaching.
shots.av-8: the end of the wide boulevard: at the left a short steep street with a stone staircase beside it climbs to an upper level; the boulevard continues straight ahead as a narrower ring road. The car is seen from BEHIND, close to the foot of the steep street.
shots.rn-1: a calmer upper ring road with 19th-century 5-storey facades, one lane each way with parking bays and plane trees, wrought-iron balconies. The car is seen in rear three-quarter view driving along it.
shots.en-s: the foot of a short steep street (stone retaining walls, a stone staircase on one side, old lamp posts) that climbs from the lower boulevard to an upper ring road. The car is seen from BEHIND at the very bottom of the slope, about to climb.
shots.en-n: camera at the top of the short steep street looking down the slope: the car is seen from the FRONT arriving at the top, where the street meets an upper ring road with 19th-century facades and plane trees; stone staircase on one side.
shots.lb-1: the upper ring road where a narrow winding old-town street begins: an arched entrance to an old quarter of 3-storey houses with shutters and flower pots. The car is seen from BEHIND turning into the narrow street.
shots.lb-2: a narrow winding stone-paved old-town street, one lane, 3-4 storey old houses with shutters, flower pots and hanging laundry, the street curving downhill to the right. The car is seen from BEHIND.
shots.lb-3: a tight bend in the same narrow winding stone-paved old-town street, a small chapel facade, old lamps on brackets. The car is seen from the FRONT coming round the bend.
shots.lb-4: camera on a lower ring road (wider street, warm brick-paved sidewalks, iron lamp posts) looking at the mouth of a narrow stone alley of the old quarter; the car is seen from the FRONT emerging from the alley onto the lower ring road.
shots.lb-5: camera on the upper ring road (plane trees, 19th-century facades) looking at the mouth of a narrow stone alley of the old quarter; the car is seen from the FRONT emerging from the alley onto the upper ring road.
shots.lb-6: another alley mouth on the lower ring road (brick sidewalks, iron lamp posts); several narrow alleys open onto this street close together. The car is seen from the FRONT emerging from one of them.
shots.lb-7: another alley mouth on the upper ring road (plane trees, 19th-century facades); narrow alleys open here every few metres. The car is seen from the FRONT emerging from one of them.
shots.lb-8: the lower ring road near the old quarter's edge, alley mouths packed very closely together, brick sidewalks, iron lamp posts. The car is seen from the FRONT emerging from an alley.
shots.lb-9: the upper ring road near the old quarter's edge, alley mouths packed very closely together under arches, plane trees. The car is seen from the FRONT emerging from an alley.
shots.lb-10: the lower ring road right at the edge of a small square with a clock tower visible at the end of the street; a very narrow alley mouth. The car is seen from the FRONT emerging from it.
shots.pl-1: the north corner of a small square with a stone clock tower; a slip road leads from the square up to a motorway. The car is seen from BEHIND leaving the square onto the slip road.
shots.au-1: a motorway slip road rising between concrete barriers, a large overhead gantry with blue direction signs (no legible text) ahead, the city behind. The car is seen from BEHIND.
shots.au-2: a three-lane motorway leaving the city, apartment blocks on both sides becoming sparser, concrete median barrier, overhead gantry. The car is seen from BEHIND.
shots.au-3: a three-lane motorway seen from an overhead gantry camera, a railway line with catenary running parallel on the right behind a fence. The car is seen from the FRONT approaching.
shots.au-4: a three-lane motorway beside a railway line on the right, low warehouses and fields, the city skyline behind. The car is seen from BEHIND.
shots.au-5: a three-lane motorway at the northern edge of the city, the railway still parallel on the right, scrubland and hills ahead. The car is seen from BEHIND.
shots.au-6: a three-lane motorway in open countryside, the railway parallel on the right, a city-limit gantry, hills. The car is seen from BEHIND, quite far but plate still readable.
